subject: general
question: The transformation ratio (K) of a transformer is defined as:

options.text: the ratio of the secondary voltage (V2) to the primary voltage (V1)
. the ratio of the primary EMF (E1) to the secondary EMF (E2)
the ratio of the primary voltage (V1) to the secondary voltage (V2)
the ratio of the number of primary turns (N1) to the number of secondary turns (N2)

solution:
The correct answer is __the ratio of the secondary voltage (V2) to the primary voltage (V1)**(Transformation Ratio)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The transformation ratio (K)__ of a transformer is a critical parameter.
 
• The transformation ratio is defined as the ratio of secondary voltage (V2) to primary voltage (V1).
 
• A transformer functions based on electromagnetic induction between its primary and secondary windings.
 
• The transformation ratio also relates to the ratio of the number of turns in the primary and secondary windings.
 
• In an ideal transformer, power remains constant between the primary and secondary sides.
 
• Depending on the value of K, a transformer can be classified as step-up or step-down.
 
• Transformers are widely used in power transmission, voltage regulation, and electrical isolation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Step-Up Transformer:**

 
 
• Increases the voltage from primary to secondary.
 
• Used in transmission systems to reduce power losses.
 
 
 
• **Step-Down Transformer:**
 
 
• Decreases the voltage from primary to secondary.
 
• Commonly used in household appliances and equipment.
 
 
 
• **Isolation Transformer:**
 
 
• Provides electrical isolation between primary and secondary circuits.
 
• Enhances safety and reduces noise in sensitive equipment.
